reviews.name: Anand R.
reviews.text: Upgraded my XUV700 headlights with bi-LED projectors. The highway illumination between Chennai and Bengaluru is phenomenal now. Clean coupler-to-coupler installation with no error codes on the MID.

reviews.name: Divya Meenakshi
reviews.text: Got custom bucket-fit seat covers stitched in dual-tone tan and black. The stitching finish and contour fit look like an OEM top-end variant. Extremely courteous team at their Adambakkam studio.

reviews.name: Vigneshwaran P.
reviews.text: Installed symphony ambient lighting with app control. The optical strips are tucked seamlessly into the door grooves with zero visible wires. Night drives feel so premium.

reviews.name: Saravanan B.
reviews.text: Full 4-door damping sheets and component speaker upgrade completely transformed the acoustic experience. Road rumble on the bypass is drastically reduced.

reviews.name: Deepak Kumar
reviews.text: The 360-degree camera calibration was done with utmost precision using optical floor mats. Makes tight basement parking in T. Nagar stress-free.

reviews.name: Naveen Chandran
reviews.mod: Heavy-Duty Side Running Steps & Door Visors
reviews.text: Fitted heavy-duty aluminum side steps for family convenience. Rock solid fitment bolted directly to chassis points without drilling. Delivery was prompt.

highlights.name: Anand R.
highlights.text: Bi-LED headlights upgrade — phenomenal highway illumination and clean coupler-to-coupler installation.

highlights.name: Divya Meenakshi
highlights.text: Custom bucket-fit seat covers in dual-tone tan and black with OEM-level craftsmanship.

highlights.name: Vigneshwaran P.
highlights.text: 18-zone symphony ambient lighting tucked seamlessly into factory door crevices with zero visible wires.
